
** Notifications

**** Preface

So notifications for a good bit were just stashed into settings, but as
we scale this to work also on native platforms it makes a bit more
sense to centralize them.

They are technically an overlay, so we'll group them here also.

**** Notification Script


***** First Iteration Notes

So, since we're utilizing Clojurescript and the WASM we actually don't have a very
clean way to use native push notifs. Sygnal forwards them as silent notifications
effectively. Now, that could be worked around... but we stil would want to
decrypt the payload when it arrives. Or at least have the option to.

So what if we made a 'second' client of sorts to run natively. It could be quite
small and just perform the task of registering a pusher and decrypting a message.
Easy. We just need to make sure we name it eloquently (and likely we don't
want to actually allow the native main client to register its own pusher. There
would be no point.)


Now this is something I considered greatly, but given the current state of the FFI bindings
and the WASM... It isn't exactly easily feasible to just use the same device for our
native notifications if we wish to decrypt the notifications.

At a later point we can look to making a Capacitor plugin to spin up the WASM in its
own executable environment and let it use native storage. Then we can see
if it is reasonably performant enough to boot a WASM executable environment like WAMR.
Or even particularly reasonable. It may work better to actually just use the Kotlin
and Swift components respectively and make a clean mapping layer to make our code
nicely portable. For now though, this implementation will do.
Even if it changes, the plugin work for Capacitor is still needed anyway,
so it isn't as though this portion was exactly the tedious part.


A further consideration might be storing the client info in the same style we do
in the main application. So we wat to store them in a user-id key and activate
them using the user-id.
I don't know that we can easily allow multiple account notifications just due
to the expensive nature of the DBs in memory. It'll need some investgating
before implementation.
So we need to ensure there is visible clarity to this shortcoming provided
to the user.

***** Second Iteration Notes

We actually ended up moving away from the WASM directly and Matrix.
A truly modular chat client shouldn't care about protocol after all.
So instead we need a way to make notifications work for Matrix (as it is still
our protocol to build against for now) without bundling ANY code that knows
about Matrix.

The idea and concept are elaborated in far greater depth in the repos where
this is solved, so I won't bother re-hashing that wealth of info and instead
just link to them.

The short is load a WASM converted to JS that runs in a sort of QuickJS environment
in which we've provided the decrypting functionality and such.
https://github.com/Paradise-Chat/paradise-matrix-push-crypto


Then on the gateway end we need a multiplexing gateway. The concept was inspired
by K8s ingress routes and is dynamically updatable without downtime to match
how we want our actual client works.
So new protocols can be added and supported by the gateway without much overhead.
https://github.com/Paradise-Chat/paradise-push



#+begin_src clojurescript :tangle ../../../../src/paradise/ui/overlays/notifications.cljs
(def shadow-device (registerPlugin "ShadowDevice"))

(defn- resolve-app-id []
  (let [cfg @!config]
    (case (platform/current-platform)
      "ios"     (:app-id-ios cfg)
      "android" (:app-id-android cfg)
      (or (:app-id-web cfg) (:app-id cfg)))))

(defn- strip-source-map [s]
  (when s
    (let [marker (str "/" "/# sourceMappingURL=")]
      (if-let [idx (str/last-index-of s marker)]
        (subs s 0 idx)
        s))))

(defn- fetch-notification-script [url]
  (-> (js/fetch url)
      (p/then (fn [resp]
                (when (.-ok resp)
                  (.text resp))))
      (p/then strip-source-map)
      (p/catch (fn [_] nil))))

(defn- active-notification-script []
  (go
    (let [res (<! (mesh/do-with-thread! :engine-pool
                                        {:handler   :get-asset-urls
                                         :arguments {}}))]
      (when (#{"success" :success} (:status res))
        (:push-url res)))))

(re-frame/reg-event-fx
 :push/sync-engine-script
 (fn [_ _]
   (when (platform/mobile-native?)
     (go
       (try
         (if-let [script-path (<! (active-notification-script))]
           (let [script-name (last (str/split script-path #"/"))
                 source      (<p! (fetch-notification-script script-path))]
             (log/info "Fetched push script:" script-name "bytes:" (count source))
             (when (and source (not (str/blank? source)))
               (.syncPushScript shadow-device
                                #js {:scriptName   script-name
                                     :scriptSource source})))
           (log/error "No push-url returned from engine"))
         (catch :default e
           (log/error "Failed to sync notification script:" e)))))
   {}))
#+end_src


**** Shadow Client

The idea of a shadow client remains integral as we don't know WHAT some protocols
will expect and so the easiest way to handle any is to make sure we're not
particularly restrictive instead.

If the protocol needs some help then the ShadowDevice is here for it. If it does
not then it is safely ignored.

(re-frame/reg-event-db

(re-frame/reg-sub

(re-frame/reg-event-fx
 :push/toggle-previews

   (store/set-setting! "show_previews" enabled?)
   (when (platform/mobile-native?)
     (-> (.setPreviewPreferences shadow-device #js {:enabled enabled?})
         (.catch #(log/error "Failed to save native preview prefs:" %))))
   {:dispatch [:push/hydrate-previews-setting enabled?]}))


(re-frame/reg-event-fx
 :push/create-sleepy-shadow
 (fn [{:keys [db]} [_ credentials]]
   (when (platform/mobile-native?)
     (log/info "Creating Sleepy Shadow Device...")
     (let [user-id (or (:user-id credentials) (:userId credentials) (:active-user-id db))]
       (go
         (try
           (if-let [script-path (<! (active-notification-script))]
             (let [script-name (last (str/split script-path #"/"))
                   source      (<p! (fetch-notification-script script-path))
                   payload     (cond-> (assoc credentials
                                              :userId             user-id
                                              :notificationScript script-name)
                                 (not (str/blank? source))
                                 (assoc :scriptSource source))
                   res         (<p! (.createSleepyShadow shadow-device (clj->js payload)))]
               (log/info "Sleepy Shadow SUCCESS:" (.-status res)))
             (log/error "Sleepy Shadow FAILED: No push-url returned from engine"))
           (catch :default e
             (log/error "Sleepy Shadow FAILED:" e))))))
   {}))

(re-frame/reg-event-fx
 :push/activate-shadow
 (fn [{:keys [db]} [_ token]]
   (let [active-user (:active-user-id db)
         old-user    (:active-push-user db)
         voip-token  (:voip-token db)
         app-id      (resolve-app-id)
         plat        (platform/current-platform)]
     (go
       (try
         (when (and old-user (string? old-user) (not= old-user active-user))
           (try
             (<p! (.deactivateShadow shadow-device
                                     #js {:pushToken token
                                          :voipToken (or voip-token "")
                                          :userId    old-user
                                          :appId     app-id
                                          :platform  plat}))
             (catch js/Error e
               (log/warn "Silent deactivate cleanup error:" e))))
         (<p! (.activateShadow shadow-device
                               #js {:pushToken token
                                    :voipToken (or voip-token "")
                                    :pushUrl   (:push-url @!config)
                                    :userId    active-user
                                    :appId     app-id
                                    :platform  plat}))
         (re-frame/dispatch [:push/set-active-user active-user])
         (catch js/Error err
           (log/error "Shadow Activated FAILED:" err)
           (re-frame/dispatch [:modal/open-shadow-login]))))
     {})))

(re-frame/reg-event-fx
 :push/deactivate-shadow
 (fn [{:keys [db]} _]
   (let [token       (:native-token db)
         target-user (:active-push-user db)
         app-id      (resolve-app-id)
         plat        (platform/current-platform)]
     (when (and target-user (string? target-user))
       (go
         (try
           (<p! (.deactivateShadow shadow-device
                                   #js {:pushToken (or token "")
                                        :userId    target-user
                                        :appId     app-id
                                        :platform  plat}))
           (catch js/Error e
             (log/error "Shadow Deactivated FAILED:" e)))
         (re-frame/dispatch [:push/hydrate-status nil])))
     {})))

(re-frame/reg-event-fx
 :push/verify-shadow
 (fn [_ [_ user-id recovery-key]]
   (when (platform/mobile-native?)
     (go
       (try
         (let [prep    (<! (mesh/do-with-thread!
                            :engine-pool
                            {:handler   :prepare-push-verification
                             :arguments {:user-id      user-id
                                         :recovery-key recovery-key}}))
               payload (merge {:userId      user-id
                               :recoveryKey (or recovery-key "")}
                              (:verification-data prep))]
           (<p! (.verifyShadow shadow-device (clj->js payload)))
           (log/info "Shadow device verified successfully."))
         (catch js/Error e
           (log/error "Shadow verification failed:" e)))))
   {}))

(re-frame/reg-event-fx
 :push/check-verification-status
 (fn [_ [_ user-id]]
   (when (platform/mobile-native?)
     (-> (.getShadowStatus shadow-device #js {:userId user-id})
         (.then (fn [res]
                  (when (.-isVerified res)
                    (log/info "Shadow client is already verified, skipping prompt.")
                    (re-frame/dispatch [:sdk/verification-success]))))
         (.catch #(log/error "Failed to fetch shadow status:" %))))
   {}))

**** Initialization

Now native push listeners aren't on the service worker.
In fact, on iOS we can't even have a service worker in a
reasonable manner.
Instead we have to register the listeners for the app
to utilize the nice features inside of Capacitor.

#+begin_src clojurescript :tangle ../../../../src/paradise/ui/overlays/notifications.cljs
(re-frame/reg-event-fx
 :push/store-native-token
 (fn [{:keys [db]} [_ token]]
   {:db (assoc db :native-token token)
    :fx [[:dispatch [:push/activate-shadow token]]]}))

(re-frame/reg-sub
 :push/native-token
 (fn [db _]
   (:native-token db)))

(defonce ^:private !electron-notif-wired? (atom false))

(defn init! []
  (audio/init-audio-unlock!)
  (when (and (platform/electron-platform?)
             (not @!electron-notif-wired?)
             (exists? js/window)
             (some? (.-paradiseNotifications js/window)))
    (reset! !electron-notif-wired? true)
    (let [bridge (.-paradiseNotifications js/window)]
      (when (fn? (.-onClicked bridge))
        (.onClicked bridge
                    (fn [^js payload]
                      (let [rid (when payload (.-roomId payload))
                            eid (when payload (.-eventId payload))]
                        (when (and (string? rid) (not (str/blank? rid)))
                          (if (and (string? eid) (not (str/blank? eid)))
                            (re-frame/dispatch [:rooms/select rid {:jump-event-id eid}])
                            (re-frame/dispatch [:rooms/select rid])))))))))
  (when (platform/mobile-native?)
    (re-frame/dispatch [:push/sync-engine-script])
    (.addListener PushNotifications "registration"
      (fn [token-res]
        (let [token (.-value token-res)]
          (log/info "Native Push Token Received:" token)
          (re-frame/dispatch [:push/store-native-token token]))))
    (.addListener PushNotifications "registrationError"
      (fn [err]
        (log/error "Native Push Registration Error:" (.-error err))))
    (.addListener PushNotifications "pushNotificationReceived"
      (fn [notification]
        (log/info "Foreground Push Received:" notification)))
    (.addListener PushNotifications "pushNotificationActionPerformed"
      (fn [action]
        (let [data   (.. action -notification -data)
              target (or (.-push_tag data) (.-room_id data))]
          (when target
            (log/info "User tapped notification:" target)
            (re-frame/dispatch [:nav/route-from-push target])))))))
#+end_src



**** Helper functions

Just some helper functions

#+begin_src clojurescript :tangle ../../../../src/paradise/ui/overlays/notifications.cljs
(def url-base64->uint8-array base64url->uint8)

(def ^:private buf->b64url bytes->base64url)

(defn- extract-push-keys [subscription]
  (when subscription
    (if (map? subscription)
      {:endpoint (:endpoint subscription)
       :p256dh   (or (:p256dh subscription) (get-in subscription [:keys :p256dh]))
       :auth     (or (:auth subscription) (get-in subscription [:keys :auth]))}
      (let [sub-json (try
                       (when (.-toJSON subscription)
                         (.toJSON subscription))
                       (catch :default _ nil))
            keys-obj (when sub-json (.-keys sub-json))
            endpoint (or (.-endpoint subscription)
                         (when sub-json (.-endpoint sub-json)))
            p256dh   (or (try
                           (buf->b64url (.getKey subscription "p256dh"))
                           (catch :default _ nil))
                         (when keys-obj (.-p256dh keys-obj)))
            auth     (or (try
                           (buf->b64url (.getKey subscription "auth"))
                           (catch :default _ nil))
                         (when keys-obj (.-auth keys-obj)))]
        {:endpoint endpoint
         :p256dh   p256dh
         :auth     auth}))))

#+end_src

#+begin_src clojurescript :tangle ../../../../src/paradise/ui/overlays/notifications.cljs
(re-frame/reg-event-fx
 :push/register-pusher
 (fn [{:keys [db]} [_ subscription]]
   (let [owner-id                      (or (:active-user-id db)
                                           (:user-id db)
                                           (:auth/user-id db)
                                           "enabled")
         {:keys [endpoint p256dh auth]} (extract-push-keys subscription)
         app-id                        (resolve-app-id)
         push-url                      (:push-url @!config)]
     (cond
       (not app-id)   (log/error "Missing app-id!")
       (not push-url) (log/error "Missing push-url!")
       (not p256dh)   (log/error "Missing p256dh key from browser subscription!")
       (not auth)     (log/error "Missing auth key from browser subscription!")
       :else
       (go
         (let [res (<! (mesh/do-with-thread! :engine-pool
                                             {:handler   :register-pusher
                                              :arguments {:p256dh   p256dh
                                                          :auth     auth
                                                          :endpoint endpoint
                                                          :app-id   app-id
                                                          :push-url push-url
                                                          :app-name (:app-name @!config)
                                                          :lang     (or js/navigator.language "en")}}))]
           (if (#{"success" :success} (:status res))
             (do
               (log/info "Web Pusher registered successfully!")
               (store/set-setting! "web_push_owner" owner-id)
               (re-frame/dispatch [:push/hydrate-status owner-id]))
             (log/error "Server rejected Web Pusher:" res))))))
   {}))

(re-frame/reg-event-fx
 :push/remove-pusher
 (fn [_ [_ pushkey]]
   (let [app-id (resolve-app-id)]
     (go
       (let [res (<! (mesh/do-with-thread! :engine-pool
                                           {:handler   :remove-pusher
                                            :arguments {:pushkey pushkey
                                                        :app-id  app-id}}))]
         (if (= (:status res) "success")
           (log/info "Successfully removed Web Pusher.")
           (log/error "Failed to remove Web Pusher:" (:msg res))))))
   {}))

(re-frame/reg-event-fx
 :push/clear-all
 (fn [{:keys [db]} _]
   (go
     (let [res (<! (mesh/do-with-thread! :engine-pool {:handler :clear-all-pushers}))]
       (if (= (:status res) "success")
         (do
           (log/info "Successfully eradicated all pushers.")
           (when (and (not (platform/mobile-native?))
                      (not (platform/electron-platform?)))
             (when-let [sw (.-serviceWorker js/navigator)]
               (-> (.-ready sw)
                   (.then (fn [reg]
                            (-> (.. reg -pushManager getSubscription)
                                (.then (fn [sub]
                                         (when sub (.unsubscribe sub))))))))))
           (when (platform/electron-platform?)
             (store/set-setting! "desktop_notifs_enabled" false))
           (when (platform/mobile-native?)
             (let [token       (:native-token db)
                   target-user (:active-push-user db)
                   app-id      (resolve-app-id)
                   plat        (platform/current-platform)]
               (when target-user
                 (.deactivateShadow shadow-device
                                    #js {:pushToken (or token "")
                                         :userId    target-user
                                         :appId     app-id
                                         :platform  plat}))))
           (store/set-setting! "web_push_owner" nil)
           (re-frame/dispatch [:push/hydrate-status nil]))
         (log/error "Failed to clear pushers:" (:msg res)))))
   {}))

 :push/status

 :push/set-status

   (assoc db :push-status status)))

(defn check-web-push-status! [dispatch-cb]
  (if-let [sw (.-serviceWorker js/navigator)]
    (-> (.-ready sw)
        (.then (fn [reg]
                 (-> (.. reg -pushManager getSubscription)
                     (.then (fn [sub]
                              (dispatch-cb (some? sub))))))))
    (dispatch-cb false)))

(re-frame/reg-event-db
 :push/hydrate-status
 (fn [db [_ active-push-user]]
   (assoc db :active-push-user active-push-user
             :push-status (if active-push-user :enabled :disabled))))

(re-frame/reg-event-fx
 :push/check-status
 (fn [{:keys [db]} _]
   (cond
     (platform/mobile-native?)
     (go
       (try
         (let [res       (<p! (.getActivePushUser shadow-device))
               user      (.-activeUser res)
               safe-user (if (identical? user js/undefined) nil user)]
           (re-frame/dispatch [:push/hydrate-status safe-user]))
         (catch js/Error e
           (log/error "Failed to check native push status:" e))))

     (platform/electron-platform?)
     (-> (store/get-setting "desktop_notifs_enabled")
         (.then (fn [saved]
                  (let [on? (if (boolean? saved) saved true)]
                    (re-frame/dispatch
                     [:push/hydrate-status
                      (when on? (or (:active-user-id db) "enabled"))]))))
         (.catch (fn [_]
                   (re-frame/dispatch
                    [:push/hydrate-status (or (:active-user-id db) "enabled")]))))

     :else
     (check-web-push-status!
      (fn [is-enabled?]
        (if is-enabled?
          (-> (store/get-setting "web_push_owner")
              (.then #(re-frame/dispatch [:push/hydrate-status (or % (:active-user-id db) "enabled")])))
          (re-frame/dispatch [:push/hydrate-status nil])))))
   {}))

***** Push Enable (Prompt User) / Disable

#+begin_src clojurescript :tangle ../../../../src/paradise/ui/overlays/notifications.cljs
(re-frame/reg-event-fx
 :push/enable
 (fn [{:keys [db]} _]
   (cond
     (platform/mobile-native?)
     (go
       (try
         (let [perm (<p! (.requestPermissions PushNotifications))]
           (if (= (.-receive perm) "granted")
             (if-let [token (:native-token db)]
               (re-frame/dispatch [:push/activate-shadow token])
               (.register PushNotifications))
             (log/warn "Native notification permission denied.")))
         (catch js/Error e
           (log/error "Native Push setup failed:" e))))

     (platform/electron-platform?)
     (let [owner (or (:active-user-id db) "enabled")]
       (store/set-setting! "desktop_notifs_enabled" true)
       (re-frame/dispatch [:push/hydrate-status owner]))

     :else
     (if-not (and (exists? js/window.PushManager) (exists? js/navigator.serviceWorker))
       (do (log/error "Push messaging is not supported.") {})
       (-> (p/let [permission (js/Notification.requestPermission)]
             (if (= permission "granted")
               (p/let [reg          (.-ready js/navigator.serviceWorker)
                       existing-sub (.getSubscription (.-pushManager reg))
                       sub          (if existing-sub
                                      existing-sub
                                      (.subscribe (.-pushManager reg)
                                                  #js {:userVisibleOnly      true
                                                       :applicationServerKey (url-base64->uint8-array (:vapid-key @!config))}))]
                 (re-frame/dispatch [:push/register-pusher (extract-push-keys sub)]))
               (log/warn "Notification permission denied.")))
           (p/catch #(log/error "Push setup failed:" %)))))
   {}))

(re-frame/reg-event-fx
 :push/disable
 (fn [_ _]
   (cond
     (platform/mobile-native?)
     {:dispatch [:push/deactivate-shadow]}

     (platform/electron-platform?)
     (do
       (store/set-setting! "desktop_notifs_enabled" false)
       {:dispatch [:push/hydrate-status nil]})

     :else
     (do
       (when-let [sw (.-serviceWorker js/navigator)]
         (-> (.-ready sw)
             (.then (fn [reg]
                      (-> (.. reg -pushManager getSubscription)
                          (.then (fn [sub]
                                   (when sub
                                     (let [{:keys [p256dh]} (extract-push-keys sub)]
                                       (when p256dh
                                         (re-frame/dispatch [:push/remove-pusher p256dh]))
                                       (.unsubscribe sub))))))))))
       (store/set-setting! "web_push_owner" nil)
       {:dispatch [:push/hydrate-status nil]}))))
#+end_src

**** In-App Toast Alerts & Notification Preferences

Audio cue synthesis and gesture-unlock live in ~paradise.shared.utils.audio~.
This section manages notification preferences, deduplication, desktop alerts,
and the in-app toast queue.

#+begin_src clojurescript :tangle ../../../../src/paradise/ui/overlays/notifications.cljs
(def init-audio-unlock! audio/init-audio-unlock!)
(def play-notification-sound! audio/play-notification-sound!)

(defonce !in-app-toasts (r/atom []))
(defonce ^:private !recent-notif-cache
  (mem-cache/make-ttl-cache {:ttl-ms 8000 :max-entries 200 :session-scoped? true}))

(re-frame/reg-sub
 :notif/toasts-enabled?
 (fn [db _]
   (if (boolean? (:notif/toasts-enabled? db))
     (:notif/toasts-enabled? db)
     true)))

(re-frame/reg-sub
 :notif/sound-enabled?
 (fn [db _]
   (if (boolean? (:notif/sound-enabled? db))
     (:notif/sound-enabled? db)
     true)))

(re-frame/reg-sub
 :notif/sound-preset
 (fn [db _] (keyword (or (:notif/sound-preset db) :chime))))

(re-frame/reg-sub
 :notif/sound-volume
 (fn [db _] (let [v (:notif/sound-volume db)] (if (number? v) v 70))))

(re-frame/reg-event-db

 (fn [db [_ enabled?]]
   (assoc db :notif/toasts-enabled? (if (boolean? enabled?) enabled? true))))

(re-frame/reg-event-db
 :notif/hydrate-sound-enabled
 (fn [db [_ enabled?]]
   (assoc db :notif/sound-enabled? (if (boolean? enabled?) enabled? true))))

(re-frame/reg-event-db
 :notif/hydrate-sound-preset
 (fn [db [_ preset]]
   (assoc db :notif/sound-preset (keyword (or preset :chime)))))

(re-frame/reg-event-db
 :notif/hydrate-sound-volume
 (fn [db [_ vol]]

(re-frame/reg-event-fx
 :notif/set-toasts-enabled
 (fn [{:keys [db]} [_ enabled?]]
   (let [v (boolean enabled?)]
     (store/set-setting! "in_app_toasts_enabled" v)
     {:db (assoc db :notif/toasts-enabled? v)})))

(re-frame/reg-event-fx
 :notif/set-sound-enabled
 (fn [{:keys [db]} [_ enabled?]]
   (let [v (boolean enabled?)]
     (store/set-setting! "in_app_sound_enabled" v)
     {:db (assoc db :notif/sound-enabled? v)})))

(re-frame/reg-event-fx
 :notif/set-sound-preset
 (fn [{:keys [db]} [_ preset]]
   (let [kw (keyword (or preset :chime))]
     (store/set-setting! "in_app_sound_preset" (name kw))
     {:db (assoc db :notif/sound-preset kw)})))

(re-frame/reg-event-fx
 :notif/set-sound-volume
 (fn [{:keys [db]} [_ vol]]
   (let [v (max 0 (min 100 (int (or vol 70))))]
     (store/set-setting! "in_app_sound_volume" v)
     {:db (assoc db :notif/sound-volume v)})))

(re-frame/reg-event-fx
 :notif/test-sound
 (fn [{:keys [db]} [_ preset-override]]
   (audio/play-notification-sound!
    {:preset   (or preset-override (:notif/sound-preset db) :chime)
     :volume   (:notif/sound-volume db 70)
     :mention? false
     :force?   true})
   {}))

(defn dismiss-toast! [toast-id]
  (swap! !in-app-toasts (fn [items] (vec (remove #(= (:id %) toast-id) items)))))

(re-frame/reg-event-fx
 :notif/clear-toasts
 (fn [_ _]
   (reset! !in-app-toasts [])
   (mem-cache/clear! !recent-notif-cache)
   {}))

(defn- page-visible-and-focused? []
  (and (exists? js/document)
       (= (.-visibilityState js/document) "visible")
       (or (not (fn? (.-hasFocus js/document)))
           (.hasFocus js/document))))

(defn- duplicate-notif? [dedupe-key]
  (mem-cache/prune-expired! !recent-notif-cache)
  (if (mem-cache/get-fresh !recent-notif-cache dedupe-key)
    true
    (do
      (mem-cache/put! !recent-notif-cache dedupe-key true)
      false)))

(defn- show-desktop-notification!
  [{:keys [room-id event-id title body avatar-url desktop-enabled? sound-on?]}]
  (let [os-silent? (boolean (or (not sound-on?) (audio/audio-playback-ready?)))]
    (cond
      (platform/mobile-native?)
      nil

      (and (platform/electron-platform?)
           desktop-enabled?
           (exists? js/window)
           (some? (.-paradiseNotifications js/window)))
      (try
        (.show (.-paradiseNotifications js/window)
               #js {:title   (or title "Paradise")
                    :body    (or body "")
                    :roomId  room-id
                    :eventId event-id
                    :silent  os-silent?})
        (catch :default _ nil))

      (and (or (not (platform/electron-platform?)) desktop-enabled?)
           (exists? js/Notification)
           (= (.-permission js/Notification) "granted"))
      (try
        (let [opts (clj->js (cond-> {:body (or body "") :silent os-silent?}
                              (and (string? avatar-url) (not (str/blank? avatar-url)))
                              (assoc :icon avatar-url)))
              n    (js/Notification. (or title "Paradise") opts)]
          (set! (.-onclick n)
                (fn [_]
                  (when (and (exists? js/window) (fn? (.-focus js/window)))
                    (.focus js/window))
                  (if event-id
                    (re-frame/dispatch [:rooms/select room-id {:jump-event-id event-id}])
                    (re-frame/dispatch [:rooms/select room-id]))
                  (.close n))))
        (catch :default _ nil)))))

(re-frame/reg-event-fx
 :notif/push-audio-cue
 (fn [{:keys [db]} [_ {:keys [room-id event-id is-mention?]}]]
   (let [rid          (some-> room-id str not-empty)
         own-status   (keyword (or (:own-status db) :online))
         dnd?         (= own-status :dnd)
         focused?     (page-visible-and-focused?)
         active-same? (and focused? rid (= (str (:active-room-id db)) rid))
         sound-on?    (if (boolean? (:notif/sound-enabled? db))
                        (:notif/sound-enabled? db)
                        true)
         preset       (keyword (or (:notif/sound-preset db) :chime))
         volume       (if (number? (:notif/sound-volume db)) (:notif/sound-volume db) 70)
         dedupe-key   (when (and rid (not-empty (str event-id)))
                        [rid (str event-id)])]
     (when (and sound-on?
                (not dnd?)
                (not active-same?)
                (or (nil? dedupe-key)
                    (not (duplicate-notif? dedupe-key))))
       (play-notification-sound!
        {:preset   preset
         :volume   volume
         :mention? (boolean is-mention?)})))
   {}))

(re-frame/reg-event-fx
 :notif/incoming
 (fn [{:keys [db]} [_ {:keys [room-id event-id room-name sender-name avatar-url body is-dm? is-mention? ts]}]]
   (let [rid          (some-> room-id str not-empty)
         own-status   (keyword (or (:own-status db) :online))
         dnd?         (= own-status :dnd)
         focused?     (page-visible-and-focused?)
         active-same? (and focused? rid (= (str (:active-room-id db)) rid))
         dedupe-key   [rid (or (not-empty (str event-id))
                               (str (or ts 0) ":" (subs (str (or body "")) 0 (min 64 (count (str (or body "")))))))]
         toasts-on?   (if (boolean? (:notif/toasts-enabled? db))
                        (:notif/toasts-enabled? db)
                        true)
         sound-on?    (if (boolean? (:notif/sound-enabled? db))
                        (:notif/sound-enabled? db)
                        true)
         previews-on? (if (boolean? (:push/previews-enabled? db))
                        (:push/previews-enabled? db)
                        true)
         preset       (keyword (or (:notif/sound-preset db) :chime))
         volume       (if (number? (:notif/sound-volume db)) (:notif/sound-volume db) 70)]
     (when (and rid
                (not dnd?)
                (not active-same?)
                (not (duplicate-notif? dedupe-key)))
       (when sound-on?
         (play-notification-sound!
          {:preset   preset
           :volume   volume
           :mention? (boolean (or is-mention? is-dm?))}))
       (let [clean-room   (or (not-empty (str/trim (str (or room-name "")))) rid)
             clean-sender (not-empty (str/trim (str (or sender-name ""))))
             clean-body   (when previews-on?
                            (not-empty (str/trim (str (or body "")))))
             toast        {:id          (str (random-uuid))
                           :room-id     rid
                           :event-id    (not-empty (str (or event-id "")))
                           :room-name   clean-room
                           :sender-name clean-sender
                           :avatar-url  avatar-url
                           :body        clean-body
                           :is-dm?      (boolean is-dm?)
                           :is-mention? (boolean is-mention?)
                           :ts          (or ts (js/Date.now))}]
         (when toasts-on?
           (swap! !in-app-toasts
                  (fn [items]
                    (->> (conj (vec items) toast)
                         (take-last 4)
                         vec))))
         (when-not focused?
           (show-desktop-notification!
            {:room-id          rid
             :event-id         (:event-id toast)
             :title            (if (and clean-sender (not is-dm?) (not= clean-sender clean-room))
                                 (str clean-sender " • " clean-room)
                                 clean-room)
             :body             (or clean-body (if is-mention? "Mentioned you" "New message"))
             :avatar-url       avatar-url
             :desktop-enabled? (= (:push-status db :enabled) :enabled)
             :sound-on?        (and sound-on? (not= preset :none) (pos? volume))})))))
   {}))

(defn ^:ui notif-toast-item [{:keys [id room-id event-id room-name sender-name avatar-url body is-dm? is-mention?]}]
  (r/with-let [!timer     (atom nil)
               start-tmr! (fn []
                            (when-let [t @!timer] (js/clearTimeout t))
                            (reset! !timer (js/setTimeout #(dismiss-toast! id) 5200)))
               stop-tmr!  (fn []
                            (when-let [t @!timer]
                              (js/clearTimeout t)
                              (reset! !timer nil)))
               _          (start-tmr!)]
    (let [tr           @(re-frame/subscribe [:i18n/tr])
          show-sender? (and sender-name (not is-dm?) (not= sender-name room-name))
          shown-body   (or body
                           (if is-mention?
                             (tr [:settings.notifications/hidden-preview-mention])
                             (tr [:settings.notifications/hidden-preview-message])))]
      [:div.notif-toast
       {:class          (when is-mention? "is-mention")
        :on-mouse-enter stop-tmr!
        :on-mouse-leave start-tmr!
        :on-click       (fn []
                          (dismiss-toast! id)
                          (if event-id
                            (re-frame/dispatch [:rooms/select room-id {:jump-event-id event-id}])
                            (re-frame/dispatch [:rooms/select room-id])))}
       [avatar {:id   room-id
                :name (or sender-name room-name "?")
                :url  avatar-url
                :size 38}]
       [:div.notif-toast-content
        [:div.notif-toast-header
         [:span.notif-toast-title room-name]
         (cond
           is-mention?
           [:span.notif-toast-pill (tr [:settings.notifications/mention-badge])]

           is-dm?
           [:span.notif-toast-pill (tr [:settings.notifications/dm-badge])])]
        (when show-sender?
          [:div.notif-toast-sender sender-name])
        [:div.notif-toast-body shown-body]]
       [:button.notif-toast-close
        {:type     "button"
         :on-click (fn [e]
                     (.stopPropagation e)
                     (dismiss-toast! id))}
        [icons/exit {:size "14px"}]]])
    (finally
      (stop-tmr!))))

(defn ^:ui notification-toast-root []
  (let [toasts @!in-app-toasts]
    (when (seq toasts)
      [:div.notif-toast-stack
       (for [toast toasts]
         ^{:key (:id toast)}
         [notif-toast-item toast])])))
#+end_src
